elements_selected.content: Implement graph::serialize_graph_index(vault_ctx) -> serde_json::Value producing the graphology serialisation format per CON-101. Stable ordering (alphabetical by slug). Pure function, no I/O. Include attributes.format='zetl-graph/v1', options.type='directed', per-node attributes {label,slug,outlink_count,backlink_count,is_orphan,is_dead,tags}.
